user_job: Recognize the active project or directory at a glance before acting.
signature_device: An asymmetric workspace identity tag with a punched locator aperture and stepped path notch.
notes: The identity-tag silhouette names a concrete object at 16 px. Its punched aperture remains deliberate, while the single stepped edge carries the filesystem-path idea without adding a second glyph. The bake-off rejected the generic folder and monitor-like placard.
